blocks.heading: Five Real Tracks, At a Glance
rows: Packaging, automotive components, consumer goods manufacturers
CIPET diploma/degree in Plastics Engineering or Polymer Technology
Chemical majors' materials R&D divisions, specialty polymer manufacturers
M.Sc/M.Tech Polymer Science or Chemistry with a polymer specialisation, PhD for senior research roles
CIPET or a dedicated rubber technology diploma/degree
B.Sc/M.Sc Chemistry or Polymer Science, with on-the-job formulation training
CIPET testing centres, in-house QC labs at manufacturers
CIPET diploma or B.Sc Chemistry, plus lab-testing certification

blocks.heading: Real Pay, Track By Track
rows: Roughly Rs 4-7 LPA, rising to Rs 12-20+ LPA at senior scientist level with a PhD and specialisation depth
